name: Multiple Importance Sampling without Selection (mismvpt)
aliases: Multi-view Path Tracing with Classical MIS
definition: A multi-view rendering estimator using Multiple Importance Sampling (MIS) without prefix selection.
summary: Multiple Importance Sampling without Selection is an unbiased multi-view rendering estimator that reuses geometric prefixes across cameras using standard MIS weights, avoiding selection bias but potentially increasing variance compared to self-normalized methods.
